headline: The canyon learns to lean into the sun
lede: Comet Drift GP's vertical walls got their follow-up polish: a smooth crest silhouette, faces that pick the sun up, per-course crest tints, fractures that stop strobing — and a grind that leaves a growing pile of grit at the wall foot. Every rule in the pass is Node-gated, and the four new mutants all die.

notes.text: Crest lines broke stride 1 near the camera — the stepped silhouette on long straights is gone, and each course now caps its walls with its own crest tint: ember at Sunset Gulch, white-hot at Noon, sandier dawn-cream on the Dunes.
The dusk sun finally has a side: faces pointing down-sun soak a warm wash, up-sun faces sit cool, and a coal edge under the crest line keeps the parallax mesas from reading through the wall haze.

A pinned grind at racing speed now sheds stone the whole time it is on the rock — the debris pile GROWS at the wall foot between the bounces, then the sand flow heals it. Banked replays stay byte-identical.

cometcheck --mutate is red on main by house pattern (expected kills accumulate). Judge branches by the diff against a baseline run, not the raw tally — this branch adds exactly 4 kills and 13 gates (489 to 502).
